source.title: On modern approaches of Hamilton-Jacobi equations and control problems with discontinuities. A guide to theory, applications, and some open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. The original zbMATH HTML fetch returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH REST API record 7814183 was used only as resolver metadata.

zbMATH metadata identified the exact source as Guy Barles and Emmanuel Chasseigne, On modern approaches of Hamilton-Jacobi equations and control problems with discontinuities. A guide to theory, applications, and some open problems, DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-49371-3, Birkhauser/Springer, 2024.

The DOI landing page at Springer was inspected and classified as paywalled_or_restricted: it states that the book is preview/subscription content and offers purchase or institutional login. Direct full-book and chapter PDF endpoints redirected back to Springer HTML/login/preview pages rather than a readable PDF artifact.

Bounded recovery attempts used the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title, and exact title plus author/search candidates. Springer, library catalog, Google Books/Google Play, and bookseller pages were rejected as metadata, preview, institutional-access, or purchase pages. A Slideshare-style repost was rejected as a non-source-authorized third-party copy rather than a reliable primary or authorized full-text source.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Per the source adequacy gate, no questions were extracted from resolver metadata, abstracts, snippets, catalogs, previews, or unauthorized reposts.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/7814183.json and outputs/latest.json.
